shortDesc: Interactive timetable and elective planner for IIT KGP CSE and ECE students.
fullDesc:
An interactive timetable scheduler and elective planning portal built for IIT Kharagpur Computer Science (CSE) and Electronics (ECE) students to customize and visualize their weekly academic calendar.

Core Idea:
Students can toggle between Computer Science and Electronics core course timetables. It features a lab batch selector for ECE students and a subslot elective planner that highlights chosen lecture slots (A, B, E, F, G, S subslots) directly on the timetable grid. It also bundles a searchable elective directory detailing slots, credits, faculty, and pre-requisites.
highlights: Interactive weekly timetable with CSE/ECE branch toggling
Dynamic elective subslot planner with automatic grid highlight overlays
Filterable depth elective directory with slots, credits, and prerequisites details
